global: This bowl holds rich, golden tonkotsu ramen broth, gently cradling tender chashu pork, crisp menma, and vibrant green onions. A single nori sheet rests atop, all nestled in a white ceramic bowl against a speckled countertop under soft, even lighting.

regions.background: Speckled light beige surface with scattered darker flecks, smooth and slightly reflective, curved gently around the bowl's base.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with glossy finish, smooth curved rim, and black circular logo near top edge.
regions.soup: The broth with noodles shows golden-brown, glossy, thick liquid swirling around pale noodles and green garnishes.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, triangular, with a slightly rough, uneven surface and visible texture.
regions.meat: The chashu pork has pinkish meat, a seared golden-brown crust, and a slightly glossy surface with visible fat marbling.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, glossy, with irregular shapes and visible fibrous texture from their natural structure.
